acceptance.assertion: Record Acer EC CPU, GPU and system temperatures plus CPU/GPU fan RPM at a reproducible light-load baseline and show a material reduction from the 2026-08-18 observed CPU 70-77 C at 2-17% CPU load and GPU 65 C before sustained stress testing.

Inspect and, where needed, service air inlets, fans, heatsink fins, heatpipe/contact condition and thermal interface material; record what was actually found rather than assuming the historical overheat damaged silicon.

Resolve the current BIOS V1.00 and Acer video-firmware state against the exact AN517-52 support package; perform BIOS/VBIOS changes only with AC power, exact model/package binding, rollback/recovery considerations and post-flash version readback.
Review Acer/OEM-relevant Intel Dynamic Tuning, Management Engine, Intel graphics and NVIDIA graphics drivers; update only justified model-compatible components and record before/after versions.

Only after the thermal baseline is safe, run a bounded sustained CPU/GPU workload and record temperatures, clocks/performance counters and any throttling evidence; distinguish thermal, power and firmware limits.

goal: Restore safe thermal headroom on Joerg's Acer Nitro AN517-52 before any sustained performance benchmark, then bring Acer-supported BIOS/video-firmware and platform-driver state to a justified baseline and measure whether sustained CPU/GPU performance has recovered.

does_not_establish: degraded thermal paste without physical inspection
metadata.live_finding: Acer EC telemetry showed CPU 70-77 C at only 2-17% CPU load, GPU 65 C, system 56-57 C, CPU fan about 2800 RPM and GPU fan about 3700 RPM. CPU PercentProcessorPerformance remained about 168-170%, so Turbo is currently available and permanent low-clock lock was not established. BIOS is V1.00 from 2020; Acer publishes an AN517-52 video-firmware performance update. Windows is High Performance with AC minimum CPU state 100% while Acer platform profile reads Balanced.
metadata.next_action: Service and remeasure cooling first; only then consider exact-model BIOS/VBIOS and platform-driver updates followed by a bounded sustained performance test.
metadata.source: Live investigation of joerg-laptop after reported overheating/slowness

rollback.strategy: Do not start sustained load or firmware mutation until the preconditions are proven. For reversible software/driver changes record the pre-state and vendor rollback path; if firmware identity or power stability is ambiguous, stop without flashing.

title: Restore AN517-52 thermal headroom and firmware baseline
